finance.title: Finance Dashboard — Fund Occupation & Ledger Compliance

widgets.title: Four-State Budget Pool Watermark
widgets.description: Allocated: RM 10,000,000 | Committed: RM 4,200,000 | Approved: RM 800,000 | Paid: RM 3,500,000 | Available: RM 1,500,000.

widgets.title: 14-Day Payout Forecast & Cashflow Matching
widgets.description: Expected payout schedule over next 14 days; daily cumulative payouts stay within Approved pool headroom.

widgets.title: Duplicate Invoice & Tax Compliance
widgets.description: Invoice alert stream: global duplicate invoice numbers (DUPLICATE_INVOICE_NUMBER), 90-day collision checks, and amount circuit breakers.

widgets.title: Four-State Ledger Transactions
widgets.description: Immutable ledger mutations (RESERVE_COMMIT, COMMIT_TO_APPROVE, RELEASE_COMMIT, PAY) with idempotency keys and timestamps.

widgets.title: Ledger Invariant Conservation Check
widgets.description: Reconciliation formula: Available = Allocated - (Committed + Approved + Paid) >= 0; delta divergence triggers immediate alert.
